# Pull request

## What kind of change is this?

- [ ] New home
- [ ] Home update
- [ ] Map, tooling, or docs

## For homes

**Slug** (`homes/<slug>/`):

**One-line story** (who are you two, and what did you build?):

### Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes with no errors
- [ ] The page is fully self-contained (no external resources, no
      trackers, no data collection)
- [ ] This home was built together by the human and AI named in
      `home.json`
- [ ] Nothing outside my home directory was touched
